title: Congestion Control in IP/TCP Internetworks
publisher_or_issuer: Ford Aerospace and Communications Corporation / RFC archival corpus

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 896 distinguishes a TCP small-packet problem from broader congestion/source-quench problems and proposes inhibiting new small sends while earlier data remains unacknowledged.
claims_extracted.locator: The two problems; The solution to the small-packet problem

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 896 describes congestion collapse in which packet loss and retransmissions can drive useful throughput drastically downward and argues that merely adding gateway buffers is not a solution.

notes: Historical Nagle memo; later TCP congestion-control algorithms must not be back-projected into it.
